'$'''cat <<-'''EVAL_HEREDOC'''
{
 for i in {1..2}, do
 ( recursive_bg 2 ) &
 done
} | tee >(cat >&2) >/dev/null &
EVAL_HEREDOC
' (3,133 us, 0.03%)

'$'''cat <<-'''NESTED'''
for ((i=0, i<2, i++)), do
 ( eval "echo NESTED-${depth}-\$i" ) &
done
wait
NESTED
' (1,022 us, 0.01%)
